records.title: build(toolchain): 镜像配置单源(pypi 3→1)+ 端到端 verify 命令
records.message:
build(toolchain): 镜像配置单源(pypi 3→1)+ 端到端 verify 命令

构建链现代化 B1a(镜像单源)+ B3(端到端绿验证),仅仓内、不动 LAN 基建。

- B1a 镜像单源:
  - 删 framework/core/package.json 死的 pypi 配置(config.pypi_mirror + 仅含死值的
    configGithub):旧消费者 run-pipenv/poetry 已随 uv 迁移删除,uv 读 pyproject
    [[tool.uv.index]],故 npm config 那两处无人消费;pypi 生效单源收敛到 pyproject。
  - kungfu-code 起手式加「镜像/缓存总览」单一发现入口:一张表登记全部上游→镜像映射
    及其权威声明位置(只指位置不复制值),读起手式即见全图。
- B3 端到端 verify:新增 verify.js + 根 "verify" 脚本(./kungfu-code verify)。
  把分散的 freeze→build:core→build:app→启 app gate 收敛成「一条命令+断言产物」:
  断言 framework/core/dist/kfc 目录、kfc 可执行、kfc --version 退 0 且版本匹配
  (运行时冒烟)、(--with-app)build:app 产物;--full 先 rebuild:core+freeze 再断言。
  作 CI smoke 基础。

验证:
- package.json/JSON 合法(node -e JSON.parse);kungfu-code sh -n 通过。
- verify.js node --check 通过;快速模式在干净 worktree 优雅报告缺产物并退 1,不崩溃。
- 完整真跑(--full,rebuild:core+freeze+断言,约数百秒,需全工具链+LAN 缓存)未在本机
  执行,留作验收门(建议在构建机/CI 跑)。
- 不解决项:npm install registry 统一(走公网)依赖 Verdaccio 透明回源 = B1b 基建,
  本轮不做。node-pre-gyp host 本地 .cc/CI .io 为有意分流,未动。

records.author: dongkeren
records.title: build(core): conan 并行度认 tools.build:jobs,大核机可封顶防 thrash
records.message:
build(core): conan 并行度认 tools.build:jobs,大核机可封顶防 thrash

conanfile.py 原硬编码 parallel_level/-j = os.cpu_count(),且经 --CDCMAKE_BUILD_PARALLEL_LEVEL
覆盖 env,大核机(如 agent-120 32 线程)无法限并行:kungfu -flto+重模板单路峰值约 2GB,
32 路并行撑爆内存换页 thrash(实测 50min,CPU 仅 0.6 核)。

改用 conan 惯用 build_jobs(self):优先读 conf tools.build:jobs(可在 profile/global.conf
按机器封顶),未设时回退 os.cpu_count() 保持原行为。封装 __parallel_jobs() 供 cmake-js
路径(--parallel/--CDCMAKE_BUILD_PARALLEL_LEVEL)与 KUNGFU_BUILD_SKIP node cmake 路径(-j)共用。

验证:py_compile 通过;agent-120 端配合 global.conf tools.build:jobs=12 验全量构建。

records.author: dongkeren
records.title: build(core): Linux nuitka freeze 改 clang 后端,避 gcc 13 ICE+跨机一致
records.message:
build(core): Linux nuitka freeze 改 clang 后端,避 gcc 13 ICE+跨机一致

gcc 13 编译 nuitka 为 scipy.stats._continuous_distns 生成的巨型 C 文件触发 internal
compiler error(cfgcleanup.cc:580 try_forward_edges, RTL cprop pass)。Mac 默认 clang
不撞。run-freeze.js 仅在 Linux 给 nuitka 加 --clang:避开 gcc ICE,并让两平台 freeze
用同一 C 编译器(clang)更可复现。需 Linux 机器装 clang(agent-120 已有 clang 18)。

验证:node --check 通过;agent-120 freeze+verify 复跑确认产物绿。

records.message:
fix(toolchain): 补齐 build-local.env 内容改动(上一提交因 add 失败只落了重命名)

上一提交 git add 含不存在 pathspec 导致整条 add 失败,只提交了 git mv 的文件重命名,
kungfu-code/.js、conanfile、.gitignore、yarn.lock 的内容改动未落。本提交补齐:

records.title: fix(core): resolve ruff lint findings
records.message:
fix(core): resolve ruff lint findings

Auto-fixed (46): unused imports, f-string placeholders, etc.
Manual (17): bare except -> except Exception (E722); ==/!= True -> truthiness
(E712); != None -> is not None (E711); type(x) == Y -> is (E721); move imports
above local TypeVar (E402); drop unused platform/sys (F841/F401). noqa with
reason on site.py side-effect imports (F401) and a latent __name__ local in
python.py variant (F841, flagged for human review).

collection.api: GitHub CLI over public GitHub GraphQL and REST APIs
collection.normalization: Public PR fields are retained; email addresses in titles and bodies are replaced with [email-redacted].

boundaries: A merged pull request is a public work item, not a feature, quality, maturity, or value unit.
The comparison observes public GitHub delivery only. Google internal work and all other private work are outside the dataset.
The scopes intentionally reflect the two real organization forms: AX is one product repository; Kungfu is a multi-repository product and release system.
Author accounts are public GitHub identities. They do not by themselves identify whether a human or an Agent produced the underlying change.
Per-author comparisons observe public responsibility identities, not verified team headcount, labor hours, employment roles, or individual authorship of every line.

Kungfu pull requests operate as settlement objects while AX pull requests follow a conventional contribution workflow; their counts are visible responsibility throughput, not interchangeable feature units.
Additions, deletions, and changed-file totals are gross PR statistics and may include generated files, vendored material, formatting, or repeated edits.

Explicit attribution markers establish some Agent participation in both repositories. AX's Gemini co-author history predates the measured windows; Kungfu's census spans the v4 bootstrap through the operating cutoff.
Attribution examples do not prove AI authorship of every change or isolate Agent use as the sole cause of the output difference.
Different review, merge, and PR-splitting disciplines remain a confounder; the raw records are published so readers can test alternative measures.
